problem: The division is written without brackets: "δ1 = 16 000 / 60 × 10⁶" and "δ2 = 24 000 / 40 × 10⁶". Read left to right (standard precedence) these give 2.67 × 10⁸ and 6.0 × 10⁸, not the stated 0.0002667 m and 0.0006000 m. A student copying the step exactly will land on a wrong number and not know why.
